description: Add a DNS record to a domain your workspace registered through Last Price, to use it for more than the storefront: MX for email, TXT for SPF, DKIM, DMARC or site verification, CNAME or A for a subdomain. name is relative (blog for blog.<domain>, empty for the domain itself). Records the storefront needs cannot be replaced. Needs a Last Price credential with workspace settings write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

domain_id.description: The domain id, from list_storefronts or add_storefront_domain.

name.description: Relative name: blog for blog.<domain>, empty for the domain itself.

value.description: The record value, such as a mail server or a target host.

name: add_storefront_dns_record
